_comment: Source of truth for MCP server registration across every harness (Claude Code, Codex, omp) — task T13. Converted at apply time by runtime/yoki/scripts/lib/mcp-inventory/writers/{claude,codex,omp}.js. `targets.<harness>` means 'this writer should emit the server', not merely 'this server happens to run under that harness' — codebase-memory-mcp and serena keep targets.claude=false even though install.sh registers them for Claude too, because that registration goes through `claude mcp add` into ~/.claude.json (a different file, untouched by this migration) and duplicating it into settings.json's mcpServers would risk two live instances of the same server. `env` values must be `${ENV_VAR}` references, never literal secrets (enforced by lib/mcp-inventory/source.js at load time) — see the dropped local 'figma' Codex entry below for the example that motivated the rule.

servers.name: codebase-memory-mcp
servers._comment: Claude side stays registered via install.sh's `claude mcp add --scope user` into ~/.claude.json — see the top-level _comment.

servers.name: serena

omp._comment: No 'omp' context exists in the serena-agent package (spike S4-S5 enumerated its fixed context set — see lib/targets/omp-mcp.js's SERENA_CONTEXT constant). 'codex' is the closest fit: both are headless, tool-calling coding-agent CLIs.
